top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Slip on Tech, Yen Snaps Winning Run: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks diverged from Wall Street’s tech-led rally as persistent volatility in South Korean equities underscored lingering concerns over the artificial intelligence trade. The yen slipped after its intervention-led gains.

top_signals.title: Rocky Debut for India Closing Auction Sparks Worries Over Expiry
top_signals.summary: India’s weekly derivatives expiry will be closely watched on Tuesday after a new closing auction system unexpectedly pushed the NSE Nifty 50 Index higher on its first day, raising questions over how the change could affect trading on one of the market’s busiest days.
